_note: Quests are listed in the tasks panel while active, in this order. trigger: "start" (new game), "manual" (only via a { "startQuest": id } effect) or { "when": condition }.
title: survive the first night
hint: The dark comes early here, and cold with it.
doneLog: Grey light over the water. You made it through the night.
The sky pales over the sea. You are still here.
Dawn, thin and cold. You lived through the first night.

title: catch a fish
hint: Fish in the shallows, and in the river. Too quick for bare hands.
doneLog: A fish, cold and slippery, and yours.
Your first fish on the island. Food the water gives.
A fish at last. You will not starve, not today.

title: climb the cliff
hint: Too steep for bare hands. Bark from the forest, twisted into a rope, would do.
doneLog: You stand on the cliff top, the rope coiled at your feet, and look inland.
The cliff is behind you. The island is bigger than you thought.

title: build a shelter
hint: Logs against the rocks, out of the wind. Firewood won't do: you need logs, and for logs, an axe.
startLog: The wind found you all night. A shelter against the rocks would keep it off.
Another night like that and the cold will win. You need a shelter.
doneLog: The wind breaks on the logs. Inside, it is almost still.
A shelter, rough but yours. The wind can't reach you here.

title: cut logs
hint: Firewood won't hold a building together. Logs will, but they need an axe.
doneLog: Real logs, heavy and straight.
Logs at last: wood to build with.

title: make a bed
hint: A frame of logs and a heap of branches, off the cold sand. You will sleep deeper.
doneLog: You lie down to try it. Off the sand, for the first time.
Not soft, but dry and off the ground. It will do.

title: build a rain barrel
hint: A hollowed log where the shelter drips. Water without the walk to the spring.
doneLog: The barrel stands under the shelter's edge, waiting for rain.
Now the rain will come to you.

title: build a drying rack
hint: Fish dried in the smoke keep, and need no fire to eat.
doneLog: The rack stands by the fire, ready for fish.
A rack for drying fish. Food for the bad days.

title: build a fish trap
hint: 20 willow twigs from the river. It can stand wherever there are fish: the shallows or the river.
doneLog: The trap is set. The fish will come to it.
Willow and patience. Now the fish do the work.

title: set snares
hint: Rope nooses on the small trails. Rope is twisted from bark strips (craft menu).
doneLog: The snares wait along the trails.
Nooses on the runs. Now leave them alone.

title: grow mushrooms
hint: Cut the fallen oak into logs and keep them wet. Needs the axe.
doneLog: The logs lie in the shade. Keep them wet, and wait.
Oak logs in the damp. The mushrooms will come.

title: dig a corn field
hint: Break the flat ground with a hoe and sow wild corn: 2 ears for the first rows.
doneLog: Rows of dark earth, sown. Three days, if the weather holds.
The field is dug and sown. Now the waiting.

title: build a bee hive
hint: A hollow log among the flowers, for the wild bees.
doneLog: The hive log stands among the flowers.
A home for the bees, if they want it.

title: build a fish weir
hint: A wall of stones and stakes across the river: more fish than a trap. Stones from the beach.
doneLog: The weir stretches across the river. The water runs through; the fish don't.
A wall across the river, with one way in.
